desc_zh: 在被惊破天的巨炮化为灰烬后，红蜘蛛那不可磨灭的火种怨念化作不死鬼魂游荡在宇宙之间。拥有穿透实体防御的幽能，以及鬼魅般的全时悬浮飞行机动。
note: 经典G1 侦查系 [特性: 鬼魂侦查系，全时悬浮飞行与高额暴击]

abilities.desc_zh: 全时处于悬浮鬼魂形态，所有近战与远程攻击对其有 30% 几率直接穿透虚化 (Miss)，不造成伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Hovering perpetually in spirit form gives a 30% chance for all incoming attacks to phase harmlessly through him (Miss).

abilities.desc_zh: 射线直接作用于敌方火种，造成无视护甲与护盾的纯净真实伤害。暴击率极高。
abilities.desc_en: Null-Rays strike the opponent Spark directly, inflicting pure True Damage bypassing all Armor and Shields with high Critical Chance.

abilities.desc_zh: 受到暴击时免疫额外暴击加成伤害；每次成功虚化闪避时，吸取对手 10% 能量槽。
abilities.desc_en: Immune to extra Critical Damage bonuses. Phasing through incoming attacks siphons 10% of opponent Power.

abilities.desc_zh: 受到致命伤害时，红蜘蛛化作怨灵附身对手 5 秒，令其陷入混乱反噬，并在附身结束时满血复活！
abilities.desc_en: Upon taking fatal damage, possesses the opponent for 5s dealing continuous backlash before resurrecting in ghost form!

abilities.desc_zh: 潜入虚空从背后突刺，造成无视格挡的暴击并施加破甲，削减对手 {{var_1}} 护甲持续 {{var_2}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Phases into the void and strikes from behind with unblockable Critical damage, reducing Armor by {{var_1}} for {{var_2}}s.

abilities.desc_zh: 双手抓住对手头部强行抽取火种能量，对目标施加虚弱降低其 {{var_3}} 攻击力持续 {{var_4}} 秒，同时自身恢复 {{var_5}} 生命值。
abilities.desc_en: Siphons Spark energy, inflicting Weakness reducing Attack by {{var_3}} for {{var_4}}s and repairing {{var_5}} Health.

abilities.desc_zh: 释放万千怨魂与幽冥鬼火，使对手陷入混乱持续 {{var_6}} 秒，无法获取能量并在期间受到 {{var_7}} 持续伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Releases vengeful spirits, confusing the foe for {{var_6}}s, halting power gain, and dealing {{var_7}} continuous damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 与惊破天、威震天对决时，获得 +{{var_1}} 暴击率与暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_1}} Critical Rating and Critical Damage against Galvatron or Megatron.

abilities.desc_zh: 与滑流同队时，闪避几率额外提升 {{var_2}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Evade Chance when teamed with Slipstream.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_3}} 暴击率。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_3}} Critical Rating.
